name: p99-voice
description: Open-source voice agent SDK. Build voice models free. Run them on P99 infra when you need scale.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @p99labs/protocol && npm run build -w @p99labs/voice && npm run build -w @p99labs/create-voice-agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @p99labs/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @p99labs/voice

author: P99 Labs
